# Ocean Stay Kojohama
> Three private oceanfront cabins beside the Pacific in Kojohama, Shiraoi, Hokkaido, Japan. Near Noboribetsu and Upopoy.

Canonical: https://kojohamacabins.jp/
English: https://kojohamacabins.jp/
日本語: https://kojohamacabins.jp/ja/
简体中文: https://kojohamacabins.jp/zh-cn/
Korean and Traditional Chinese marketing pages are not published yet.
In-stay guest guide (English, 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文; not a search landing page): https://guide.kojohamacabins.jp/

## Place
Published address: 595-2 Kojohama, Shiraoi, Shiraoi District, Hokkaido 059-0641, Japan.
Some booking-platform labels still show Sol or Rustic as 595-1. Use 595-2 for emergencies and navigation until those records are reconciled.
Email: admin@kagami-planning.com
LINE: https://line.me/R/ti/p/@148rlmzm
Emergency in Japan: 119 ambulance and fire; 110 police.
New Chitose Airport: about 60–80 minutes by car. Allow extra time in winter.
Sister apartments in Sapporo: https://casaantonio.jp/ (about 80–90 minutes by car).

## Cabins
- Ocean Stay Sol: up to 5 guests, 4 beds. Check-in from 15:00. Checkout by 10:00.
  Page: https://kojohamacabins.jp/cabins/ocean-stay-sol/
  Book on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1451962457697397900
- Ocean Stay Zen: up to 5 guests, 5 beds, tatami, kotatsu. Check-in from 14:00. Checkout by 10:00.
  Page: https://kojohamacabins.jp/cabins/ocean-stay-zen/
  Book on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1452755870408569390
- Ocean Stay Rustic: up to 5 guests, 4 beds. Check-in from 15:00. Checkout by 10:00.
  Page: https://kojohamacabins.jp/cabins/ocean-stay-rustic/
  Book on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1452772681885880930
Each cabin is an entire home with a kitchen, Wi-Fi, washer, heating, air-conditioning and one free parking space. Pets are not allowed. Smoking is not allowed. Children and infants are welcome within the five-guest cap.

## Prices
2026-10-16 to 2027-07-01: from ¥13,800 per night for up to 2 guests.
Cleaning is ¥7,000 per stay and is not included. Taxes are not included.
From guest 3, add ¥2,500 per person per stay.
Published weekday / weekend nightly rates before cleaning and tax:
- Ocean Stay Sol: weekday ¥15,800, weekend ¥18,800.
- Ocean Stay Zen: weekday ¥13,800, weekend ¥16,800.
- Ocean Stay Rustic: weekday ¥14,800, weekend ¥17,800.
Dated rates: https://kojohamacabins.jp/cabins/#seasonal-rates
Availability and the final total are confirmed on Airbnb. Do not quote a stay total that is not on the booking page.
Ctrip and Trip.com are not an active booking channel on this website.

## BBQ
A Coleman RoadTrip Grill LXE-J II is available by prior arrangement for ¥3,500 per stay. Guests bring two compatible gas cartridges, food, utensils and other gear. Guide: https://kojohamacabins.jp/bbq/
